payload.title: Validate emergence with frozen macro identities on H1
payload.work_clay: On frozen Ubuntu H1 episodes, discover candidate macroscales/Assemblies only on discovery traces, freeze semantic hashes, then evaluate on held-out matched interventions. Include causal-null macro-search/permutation calibration, matched micro and best pairwise/state-machine reductions, common-driver injection, lesion/rescue, truthful/shuffled/no re-entry, frozen-model-output controls, OOD transfer and cost/recovery shadows.
payload.reason_clay: This emergenz run showed strong synthetic selection bias when macro mappings are discovered and evaluated on the same finite data: null best-train MI averaged 0.06555 bit but held-out MI collapsed to 0.000147 bit. A true macro control retained ~0.514 bit held-out. Primary causal-abstraction literature also warns that unconstrained mappings can trivialize causal interpretation.
payload.completion_clay: Produce H1 Ubuntu execution receipts with preregistered/frozen macro_definition_hash, discovery/evaluation split hashes, null distribution and multiplicity control, intervention outcomes, lesion/rescue, re-entry controls, OOD transfer and micro/pairwise baselines. No emergence promotion unless the evidence ladder survives held-out tests.
